# Technology, Magic & Items

## Ben Hur {#ben-hur}

Ben Hur is a religious novel, lent to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), that features a chariot race.

## Four Sisters {#four-sisters}

The Four Sisters was a ship used by [Laurence Vane](../character/laurence.md) for a sea trip to [Havana](../codex/places.md#havana), which subsequently failed to return on its homebound voyage after departing [Havana](../codex/places.md#havana).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P25](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), +10 more_

## Royal William {#royal-william}

The Royal William is a ship that once arrived in [Seven Gulls Harbor](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-harbor) carrying the schoolmaster's bride, [Damaris Leigh](../character/damaris-leigh.md), after being delayed for eight weeks by a series of severe storms.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P24](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P25](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P26](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P27](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0027), +16 more_
